model.title: Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation Land Exchange Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Jay Obernolte (R-CA)

summary.text: The bill would authorize a land exchange between the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation and the federal government in San Bernardino County, California, in which the tribe would transfer approximately 1,460 acres to the government in exchange for approximately 1,475 acres of National Forest System land. As part of the deal, the tribe would agree to help preserve the historical and cultural significance of the Arrowhead landmark site in the San Bernardino Mountains.
